Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!

Job Details

JOB SUMMARY:

Under the direction of the Senior Director, Personalised Supply Chain (or designated regional leader), the Customer Success Project Coordinator (CS Project Coordinator) supports the Customer Success Projects team in the coordination, documentation, and execution support of customer onboarding and supply chain implementation projects. The role ensures that project plans, deliverables, and communications are organized, accurate, and completed on time, enabling a smooth setup and handover to Operations and Customer Service teams for consistent ongoing execution.

The Customer Success Projects function partners with customers and World Courier teams to optimize solutions for complex and critical supply chains, particularly within personalised supply chain (e.g., cell & gene therapy, radiopharma, and direct-to-patient). The CS Project Coordinator works closely with Customer Success Project Managers (CSPMs), Sales, Operations, Customer Solutions, IT, and Quality to support project activities such as workshop preparation, statement of work support, lane mapping administration, project documentation, KPI/reporting coordination, and IT integration tracking.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Project coordination & delivery support

  • Support CSPMs with the coordination of assigned customer success projects, maintaining project plans, timelines, trackers, and action logs.

  • Track deliverables and dependencies across functions (Sales, Ops, CS, IT, QA) and follow up on actions to support on-time implementation.

  • Maintain structured project documentation and ensure updates are captured, version-controlled, and stored appropriately.

Customer onboarding & workshop support

  • Coordinate logistics and materials for customer workshops (agendas, attendee lists, pre-reads, outputs) and capture actions/next steps.

  • Support the creation and assembly of onboarding documentation, including work instructions and statements of work drafts (as directed by CSPM and business stakeholders).

Supply chain setup administration

  • Support lane mapping activities by collecting required inputs, maintaining standard formats, and coordinating reviews/approvals.

  • Support communication and escalation plan documentation and ensure distribution to relevant internal teams during setup.

  • Coordinate training scheduling and materials distribution for customers and internal teams on special requirements (as led by CSPM/SME).

KPI/reporting & systems integration tracking

  • Assist with KPI reporting setup by gathering inputs, maintaining reporting templates, and coordinating updates (as defined by the project team).

  • Track IT/system integration activities (tasks, milestones, dependencies) and support meeting notes and follow-ups to keep workstreams aligned.

Handover & operational readiness

  • Support handover preparation to Operations and Customer Service by ensuring required project infrastructure, documentation, and readiness checks are completed and accessible. ]

  • Help coordinate issue logs during implementation and route items to the appropriate owners (CSPM, Ops, CS, IT, QA) for resolution.

General

  • Perform related duties as assigned; contribute to continuous improvement of onboarding templates, trackers, and standardized formats.

SKILLS & KNOWLEDGE

  • Strong organization, prioritization, and follow-through; ability to manage multiple workstreams and deadlines.

  • Clear written and verbal communication; confident coordinating across cross-functional teams and customer-facing stakeholders (as appropriate).

  • Solid analytical and problem-solving skills; attention to detail and documentation discipline.

  • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office tools (Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) and comfort working with structured templates and trackers.

  • Understanding of regulated/logistics or high-compliance environments is beneficial (e.g., healthcare logistics, specialty supply chains).

EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Typically requires relevant experience in project coordination, customer onboarding, operations support, or supply chain/logistics coordination.

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience preferred.

  • Project management certification (e.g., CAPM, Prince2 Foundation, PMP) is a plus but not required for the coordinator level.

You will work closely with company management to launch new ideas, validate opportunities, and build scalable GTM systems that generate measurable business impact.

What are the responsibilities of an AI Native GTM Specialist?

  • Launch new offers, microsites, landing pages, and experiments fast, often within the same day.
  • Build and manage high-converting landing pages tailored to different industries, countries, and customer segments.
  • Set up and optimize Meta campaigns, outbound outreach flows, email sequences, and lead generation systems.

raw.description:
about us:

Spectrum.Life is a whole-of-health digital partner that guides organisations and their people to thrive, delivering clinically backed digital health, mental health and wellbeing solutions.

Our HealthTech delivers digital transformation for Insurers, Educators and Employers through Co-creation or seamlessly integrated out-of-the-box solutions, that decrease digital fragmentation and engage, empower, and transform their people’s lives.

Established in 2018 by Stuart McGoldrick and Stephen Costello, Spectrum.Life provides services internationally to over 7.2m insurance members, 3,000 corporate clients, 60 universities and 650,000 university students. Spectrum.Life currently employs over 450 people.

Our vision is to change and save as many lives as possible.

role brief:

We are seeking experienced and dedicated General Practitioners (GPs) to join our remote healthcare team. This role offers the opportunity to deliver high-quality virtual consultations to patients across the UK, ensuring excellent patient outcomes and satisfaction. Please note that this role requires a minimum commitment of 4 sessions per week.

responsibilities:

Clinical Consultations:

  • Provide remote consultations via video, phone, or secure messaging platforms.
  • Diagnose, manage, and treat a range of medical conditions within the scope of primary care.
  • Prescribe medications and provide appropriate health advice.
  • Deliver preventative health services, including health screenings and lifestyle advice.
Collaboration & Referrals:
  • Liaise with other healthcare professionals and services, ensuring seamless patient care.
  • Refer patients for specialist investigations or secondary care when clinically indicated.
  • Work collaboratively with third-party healthcare providers to maintain service consistency.
Compliance & Governance:
  • Ensure adherence to GMC guidelines and clinical governance standards.
  • Maintain accurate and timely electronic medical records (EMR).
  • Participate in quality assurance activities, including audits and clinical reviews.
Patient Advocacy:
  • Promote patient-centred care by actively involving patients in decision-making.
  • Support patients in navigating healthcare systems and accessing appropriate services.
Training & Development:
  • Participate in regular training sessions, CPD activities, and peer reviews.
  • Stay updated on advancements in telemedicine and digital healthcare.

requirements:

  • Full registration with the General Medical Council (GMC) and a valid license to practice.
  • Minimum 2 years of post-qualification experience in general practice.
  • Minimum 2 years of post-qualification experience in primary care.
  • Experience or interest in digital healthcare/telemedicine is desirable.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build rapport remotely.
  • Proficiency in using electronic health record systems and telehealth platforms.
  • Availability to work flexible hours, including evenings and weekends if required.

desirable:

  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to manage a high volume of patient interactions.
  • Familiarity with remote healthcare systems and their integration into patient pathways.
  • Commitment to delivering equitable, high-quality care in a virtual setting.

what are the benefits of working at spectrum.life?

• Full-time or Part-time permanent contract
• Competitive salary and benefits package.
• Opportunity to work remotely as part of a dynamic and supportive healthcare team.
• Continuous professional development and training opportunities.
• 24/7 EAP and a wide range of health and wellbeing supports
• Extensive list of employee perks and benefits: https://app.box.com/s/6wwkvowbev6cn7tlvq9yz32amnpmnvcl

your profile

Please note that if you are successful with this application and at interview stage, you will be required to provide us with the following compliance documents:

  • 2 previous leadership work references (leadership at official email addresses or HR), their full names and email addresses
  • Proof of your eligibility to work in the jurisdiction in which you reside, i.e. a photographic copy of your passport and visa where applicable
  • Qualification certificates
  • Confirmation of your GMC number
  • Copy of Revalidation - date last completed and when its next due
  • Evidence of Hepatitis B immunity
  • Copy of your DBS check
  • Proof of performers list
  • BLS Cert
  • Safeguarding Cert
